Mets. 89ᵇ</cite> top <he>לאַכְשׁוּרֵי גברא וכ׳</he> as to making the man fitter, i.e. as to the laborer in fruits being permitted to use means for increasing his appetite, there is no question, opp. to <he>לאכשורי פירא</he> using means for making the fruits more appetizing.—
<cite ref="Zevachim 25a:1">Zeb. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>בשמאל אכשורי מַכְשַׁר</he> he (R. S.) declares it permissible to use the left hand (for <cite ref="S01474"><he>קְמִיצָה</he></cite>).
